independent_basis: literal rows, sets, maps, and hand-derived transitions; no collector or O07 metric is an oracle

native_value_scope.ordered_projection_rule: preserve_field_order; empty projection NDV is 1 for nonempty population and 0 for empty population
native_value_scope.positive_support_rule: P/E maps contain only positive counts; sum of map multiplicities equals applicable S cardinality
native_value_scope.histogram_rule: bins count keys, not multiplicity-weighted rows, unless the object is explicitly a touched-event histogram
native_value_scope.top_k_rule: count descending, then exact native key order ascending

fixtures.query_shape: R(x,y), S(y); native R root; S child; head (x,y)

post_baseline_inputs.support_change_denominator_definition: one denominator unit per individual P/E key multiplicity change; a missing key is zero; denominator is not physical inputs or touched-degree events

fixtures.query_shape: physical R(x,z) occurrence projects to native x; no z predicate

fixtures.scope_note: set-theoretic expectations under the preflight empty-projection rule; runtime constructibility of nullary layouts remains a separate check

index_event_weighting_control.query_shape: Parent(k,id), Child(k); only this isolated reverse-index event histogram illustrates weighting
